name: SeriesBot
description: A Telegram bot for managing series and movies.

API_ID.description: Your Telegram API ID from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your Telegram API HASH from my.telegram.org

ADMINS.description: Comma separated list of user IDs who will be admins of the bot.

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB connection URL (e.g., MongoDB Atlas SRV link)

DATABASE_NAME.description: Name of the database to use in MongoDB

DB_CHANNEL.description: Comma separated list of channel IDs where files are stored (e.g., -1001234567890)

REQ_CHANNEL_ONE.description: ID of the first force subscribe channel (optional)

REQ_CHANNEL_TWO.description: ID of the second force subscribe channel (optional)
